create_class_EffectRequest: create a subclass of EffectRequest to define a new effect request type with an effect protocol
create_class_EffectHandler: create a subclass of EffectHandler to wrap a model and handle effect requests at runtime
create_class_HandledEffectRef: create a subclass of HandledEffectRef as a sentinel marker for which handler handles an effect
create_class_EffectRuntimeImpl: create a subclass of EffectRuntimeImpl to implement the effect protocol at runtime
